intent.proves: The sample catalogue products are present: at least one product id carries the sample-data prefix TCPROD.
intent.scope: distinct EcomProducts ids that start TCPROD (the sample-data product id prefix; the product numbers are TC-<concept>-nnnn), counted once across languages and variants

bindings.reason: get_products is paged and filters by other keys; an id-prefix count is not equivalent.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ProductId) FROM EcomProducts WHERE ProductId LIKE N'TCPROD%'
